basis: Proposed counter-only expansion to 100 decimal GB. Preserves v2 host, wall, disk, expiry and one-dollar reservation: the fixed runner uses private namespace traffic and no public experiment target. The existing five-condition 100-Mbit/s, 30-second sweep still requires 18760000000 counter bytes; a higher ceiling does not change its declared request, duration, conditions or scientific criteria. Fresh operational qualification and exact policy/executor binding are required before activation. This is not measured charges or a guaranteed AWS bill ceiling.
